persona_summary: Georgette (81) lives in Kortrijk on her pension. In the past 48 hours two unusual payments went to an unknown account, and Doppel stopped a third.
diary_opener: Hello Georgette, I've already lived your next month. I held back one payment, so your money stays safe until we've had a chat together.

transactions.counterparty: Transfer to BE•• •••• 7719, "for Jonas phone + rent"

cards.title: Someone pretended to be family, but he wasn't
cards.body: I got a message from a 'new number' and sent €950 and €1,800. It's a well-known trick, and it's not your fault: these people are very convincing.

signals.label: A new account
signals.detail: Yesterday and today money went to an account you had never paid before

signals.label: Bigger amounts than usual
signals.detail: Your biggest payment in 5 years was €640. These were €950 and €1,800

signals.label: Messages about a 'new number'
signals.detail: Safeonweb and Febelfin warn about WhatsApp messages from someone who says they are your child or grandchild, with a new number

signals.label: You wanted to help your grandson
signals.detail: Last month you called our Kortrijk branch to ask how to send money to your grandson quickly

actions.title: Talk to Ann, your own adviser
actions.body: Ann Desmet from KBC Kortrijk knows you. She's happy to call you, or you can just drop in.

actions.title: How to spot a 'new number' message
actions.body: Three simple checks: call the old number, ask something only they would know, and never pay in a hurry. On paper too, if you like.

cards.title: Today I held back your payment of €2,400
cards.body: I didn't send that third payment. The money is safe in your account until we've had a chat together.

signals.label: A third payment was ready to go
signals.detail: You had set up €2,400 for the same account. It stays on hold until we've talked with you

signals.label: Late at night
signals.detail: You logged in at 01:40, while you normally use the app in the morning

signals.label: A new account
signals.detail: Yesterday and today money went to an account you had never paid before

actions.title: We held back a payment. Was that really you?
actions.body: Your payment of €2,400 is on hold, so nothing leaves your account. Someone from KBC will call you today to look at it calmly together.

cards.title: The next day my pension came in as usual
cards.body: On 1 October my pension of €1,890 was in the account, like every month. Nothing changed there.

signals.label: Your regular payments stay the same
signals.detail: Colruyt, the pharmacy, home care, energy: the same calm rhythm since 2019

actions.title: Your pension comes tomorrow, as always
actions.body: Your €1,890 comes in on 1 October. Your energy and home care get paid as usual.

cards.title: Two weeks in, my daughter Annick was keeping an eye out
cards.body: I chose Annick. She gets a message if something strange happens on my account. She can't pay, she can only look.
